steps.text: Coconut (5/6 g) into a dry pan, medium, 90 seconds, shaken constantly, until it just turns gold. Out of the pan immediately.
Apple (230/300 g — about 1½ / 2 medium) grated coarsely, SKIN ON. Lemon over it straight away.
Fold into the yoghurt (120/170 g) with a full teaspoon of cinnamon and a pinch of salt.
Toasted coconut and pumpkin seeds (8/11 g) over the top.

why: Skin on. That is most of the fibre in the apple and all of the texture — peeled and grated, this collapses into apple sauce with yoghurt in it.
